upheld.title: Remove redundant empty-bag coverage
upheld.detail: TC-04 repeats the empty GET state and button-absence assertion covered by TC-03. Deleted and never-filled baskets both have no Redis key and use the same rendering branch. Independent setup provides diagnostic convenience without additional behavior coverage.
upheld.requirement: Council's Useless tests rule: delete tests whose removal would let no plausible bug through; story AC4 remains covered by TC-03.

upheld.title: Reload video does not show the bag being emptied before the reload
upheld.detail: Video 03 goes from the catalog (frame-001@0) straight to the already-reloaded empty bag (frame-002@1.72); no frame shows the two-product bag or the Empty bag click, so on its own the video cannot be told apart from video 04's never-filled bag.
upheld.requirement: AC3: Given the shopping bag after emptying it, when I reload the page, then it is still empty (the bag was emptied on the server, not only on screen).

dismissed.title: Unrelated using-directive reorder in BasketState.cs
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. The using reorder in BasketState.cs:1-5 is the harness precheck auto-fix (5cfea6fe), matches .editorconfig dotnet_sort_system_directives_first and changes no behaviour; this also settles the opus 'No unrelated changes' partial row.

dismissed.title: Empty bag has no handling for a failed Basket delete
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. The failure needs a Basket API outage, which is not data a user can supply; the existing update-cart post (SetQuantityAsync) and the page's own GET fail the same way, so the change follows the existing convention and leaves no half-written state.
